title: 6.6.26 Game States — State Machine with Persistence
description: Graded: build a game with at least 4 states (title, play, pause, gameover) with full save/load integration. Saves trigger on state transitions. Continue restores the right state.

steps.title: Set up 4+ states with switch in draw()
steps.instructions: In draw(), write a switch(state) with at least four cases: 'title', 'play', 'pause', 'gameover'. Each case must end with break. Set state = 'title' in setup().
hints: Review 2.6.5 (switch with three cases) and 2.6.13 (three-state machine) for the switch pattern.

steps.title: Build the play state with player movement and score
steps.instructions: In the 'play' case, use kb.pressing for WASD or arrow-key movement. Increment score over time (frameCount % 60 === 0 is a simple timer). Display score with text().
hints: 2.6.15 (keyboard-driven transitions) and 2.6.17 (score threshold) show movement + scoring patterns.

steps.title: Implement title screen with New Game / Continue
steps.instructions: In the 'title' case, display the game name and instructions. Show 'Press N for New Game'. If a save exists (check getItem), also show 'Press C to Continue'.
hints: 2.6.11 (title screen) shows text layout for a start screen. Check localStorage with getItem().

steps.title: Implement pause state (press P, game freezes)
steps.instructions: In the 'play' case, listen for kb.presses('p') to switch state to 'pause'. In the 'pause' case, stop all movement and draw a paused overlay. Press P again to return to 'play'.
hints: 2.6.19 (pause state) shows the toggle pattern. Use kb.presses (edge-triggered) so P doesn't flicker.

steps.title: Implement game over state (condition-driven) with auto-save
steps.instructions: In the 'play' case, check a lose condition (e.g. score reaches a threshold, or player falls off screen). When it triggers, set state = 'gameover' AND call a save function. In the 'gameover' case, show final score and restart option.
hints: 2.6.17 (score threshold) for condition-driven transition. 2.6.22 (save on transition) for wiring saveGame() to state changes.

steps.title: Add save/load integration so Continue restores the correct state and data
steps.instructions: Write a saveGame() function that uses storeItem + JSON.stringify to save { state, score, playerX, playerY, ... }. Write a loadGame() function that uses getItem + JSON.parse to restore. Call saveGame() on gameover and on win. Wire Continue to loadGame().
hints: 2.5.16 (slots), 2.5.23 (auto-save), 2.6.22 (save on transition), 2.6.23 (continue loads correct state) cover the full save/load cycle.

requirements.title: switch statement used
requirements.description: Inside draw(), a switch statement controls which screen renders.

requirements.title: At least 3 case labels
requirements.description: Inside draw(), the switch has at least three case labels for different states.

requirements.title: Each case ends with break
requirements.description: The switch uses break to exit each case (otherwise the cases fall through).

requirements.title: storeItem used
requirements.description: storeItem is called to persist save data.

requirements.title: JSON.stringify used
requirements.description: Save data is serialized with JSON.stringify before storing.

requirements.title: JSON.parse used
requirements.description: Save data is deserialized with JSON.parse when loading.
